/help.description: Show Agent commands and safe exits.
/help.text:
RedSkoll Agent commands:
  /help                 show this list
  /model                current model and Ollama status
  /model list           list installed local models
  /model select NAME    switch to an installed model
  /download MODEL       print an ollama pull command only
  /offline              switch to fixed offline dialogue
  /status               story, model, and safety status
  /story                current story stage
  /context              conversation context summary
  /clear                clear Agent conversation only
  /relic                show generated relic status
  /reconstruct          inspect Echo fragments safely
  /tribute              show symbolic tribute types
  /safe                 enable low-stimulation mode
  /exit                 use the real safe exit flow

POSIX virtual commands remain available. Safe exits: /exit, exit --now, Ctrl+C twice, or close the window.

/status.description: Show model, story, and safety status.

/story.text:
Story stage: {story_act}
The next story transition remains local and fictional.

/tribute.text:
Symbolic tributes: time, fictional name, invented secret, release, virtual file.
No real credentials or files are requested.

/offline.text: Offline story mode enabled. No Ollama request will be made.

/safe.text: Low-stimulation mode enabled. Animation and high-intensity effects are disabled.

/clear.text: Agent conversation cleared. Story state and files were not changed.

/exit.description: Exit through the real safe flow.
/exit.text: Safe exit engaged. The process is ending.

/model.description: Show, list, or select local models.

/download.description: Print an ollama pull command without executing it.
